title: Field docs (bcobs-field-docs@1, D65): per table field, the ToolTip of a page control bound to it
description: data/code/field-docs/<major>.json (W1 + first-party apps of one major) and data/index/field-docs.json (the preferred major). One ToolTip per (table, field): Card and Document pages first, then List pages, then the others; an obsolete control or page last; the lowest page id on a tie. Fields a tableextension adds sit under the base table.

inputs.description: what the file was derived from (data/code/field-docs only)

tooltips.description: field controls with a ToolTip on pages (and page extensions) whose source table resolves

bound.description: of those, bound to a field of that table

unparsed.description: binding is an expression, a call or a variable of another record

unmatched.description: binding names no field of the table or its extensions (a page variable)

tables.description: table object key (table/8057) -> field name as declared -> the chosen ToolTip

page.description: object key of the page or page extension: page/8060

control.description: the control's name on that page
